aism_behavior: n/a -- the convention profile (.rk/conventions/<name>.v<n>.json, schemas/convention-profile.v1.json) is an rk-only concept introduced by rk-5lzf; no AISM script reads or validates one.
notes: rk-5lzf (Tier A, LB5): a conventionProfile naming a file that is not present is a STRUCTURAL ERROR, never silently degraded to the 'no profile configured' state. The two are different facts: the second means Gate 9 has nothing to check against and says so; the first means the campaign believes it IS being checked and is not. The fixture repo deliberately holds a well-formed qpcp.v1.json so the failure is unambiguously the REFERENCE, not the profile's contents (the finding names what is present). The config field itself is well-formed, so the field-level pair stays 1/1 and only the profile unit goes 0/1.
